1. (Currently amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion;
b. securing the finger palette to a finger;
c. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette by __removing the cosmetic product from the container using an applicator tool before depositing__; and
d. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination __using a different applicator tool than the tool used to deposit the cosmetic product__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further including the step of __blending or spreading the cosmetic product on the surface portion before transferring the cosmetic product to the destination__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein:
a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and
b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, __wherein the difference between the first quantity and the second quantity is retained on the surface portion for blending with an additional cosmetic product__.

5. (Original)

6. (Original)

7. (Original)

11. (Original)

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein:
a. the cosmetic product is a first cosmetic product __removed from a first container using a first applicator tool and deposited on a first segment of the surface portion__; and
b. the method further includes the step of depositing a second cosmetic product __removed from a second container using a second applicator tool on a non-overlapping second segment of the surface portion__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, further including the step of __blending the first cosmetic product with the second cosmetic product on the surface portion to obtain a blended cosmetic product__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further including the step of transferring the blended cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to the destination __using a third applicator tool__.

15. (Cancelled)

18. (Currently amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a work surface, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion configured to be removably and replaceably securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion extending outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter, wherein the surface portion is at least substantially smooth so as to allow a user to scrape an applicator past the surface center in an uninterrupted motion while spreading or blending cosmetic product over the entirety of the surface portion;
b. securing the finger palette to a finger by passing the finger through the ring portion;
c. __removing cosmetic product from a cosmetics container using a first applicator tool and placing a first quantity of the removed cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette__;
d. __blending or spreading the cosmetic product on the surface portion__;
e. removing cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette __using a second applicator tool__; and
f. applying a second quantity of the removed cosmetic product to a destination __using the second applicator tool__, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein:
a. the cosmetic product is a first cosmetic product __removed from a first cosmetics container using a first applicator tool and placed on a first segment of the surface portion__; and
b. the method further includes the steps of:
i. __removing a second cosmetic product from a second cosmetics container using a second applicator tool and placing a third quantity of the removed second cosmetic product on a non-overlapping second segment of the surface portion__; and
ii. blending the first cosmetic product on the surface portion with the second cosmetic product on the surface portion to obtain a blended cosmetic product, wherein the cosmetic product applied to the destination is the blended cosmetic product.
